metric_definitions.unavailable: null means absent in older telemetry, not zero.
metric_definitions.telemetry_sha256: SHA256 of the full parsed JSONL record array, sorted keys and compact separators, removing only each record wall_elapsed_ms; includes all detailed snapshots.
metric_definitions.routes: Cumulative complete route plans, not simultaneous active routes or proof of traversal.
metric_definitions.bases_connected: Directed floor graph base connectivity; not class-specific traversability.
metric_definitions.class_ascent: checks == passed + rejected + deferred. Prior runtime lacks these counters.
metric_definitions.building_damage: Cumulative actual enemy building health removed; includes defense attribution, not only core damage.
metric_definitions.spawn_count: Actual physical spawning from a buildable; evolution excluded.
metric_definitions.simulation_wall_seconds: Engine time measured inside match; startup excluded. Load/concurrency affects speed measurements.

alien_base_pressure.limitations: Distances use actual reported actor and living structure origins, not hull separation/attack range/sight. Reactor is observed, not proof of hidden planner objective. Class/target/route counts are sampled observations, not actions or exposure seconds. Final stationary means within 16 units at each of the last three snapshots, permitting intervening motion. Move-goal structure matches require distance <=1; path/debug values and ground entities are reported, not inferred hidden states.
